entities.summary: Muriel E. Mussells Seyfert was an American astronomer best known for discovering three "ring nebulae" in the Milky Way while working at the Harvard College Observatory in as a human Computer from 1927-1936. The discovery was picked up by the newswires and reported in newspapers across the country. Articles described the objects as "tremendous rings of star-dust" and that "each is believed to be hundreds of times larger than our entire solar system.
